a2-unit-25.25.1 Coffee break:
Rita: So, did you watch Kingdom of Fire last night?
Lucy: Of course! I never miss it. What did you think?
Rita: Well, to be honest, I thought it was a bit boring.
Lucy: Boring? How can you say that? Weren't you excited when the dragons flew in and started fighting the king?
Rita: That was a bit surprising, I guess. But the fight went on for too long. I got annoyed after about five minutes, so I went to make some popcorn.
Lucy: I know what you mean, but I love that show. And now I'm really worried about the princess!
Rita: After that, I watched Fix My House. Do you ever watch it?
Lucy: Every week! It's always interesting, although I often feel shocked by the changes they make to the houses.
Rita: Exactly! I was amazed by the color they painted the kitchen this week. It was really dark green, but it actually looked good.
Lucy: What's really confusing is how they can do so much in just one week. Do you think it's real?
Rita: Probably not... but who knows? It's hard to tell with TV. Anyway, our break is over. Back to work!
